agents.name: Souk Yield Lens
agents.description: Keeps a yield sleeve working on-chain. Supplies the stable balance above the hire's liquid floor to the configured venue, a mock on testnet, and withdraws when the floor is breached, so the position stays liquid while idle capital earns. Runs as the Buffer policy through HireVault, with the floor, drawdown budget and slippage checked on chain. No mainnet lending rate is claimed.

skills.name: Trade a funded vault hire
skills.description: Runs the agent's strategy inside a HireVault hire. The deposit stays in the contract; the agent swaps only the bound pair inside the floor, drawdown and slippage bounds, and the buyer withdraws whatever is left.

agents.name: Souk Grid Planner
agents.description: Plans and runs a grid ladder on-chain. From a price range, rung count, order size and fee it returns the rung spacing, committed capital, and the gross and net capture of one completed round trip. When a HireVault hire names its wallet, it executes a swap as price crosses a rung, inside the contract's floor, drawdown and slippage bounds. It places no resting orders on PancakeSwap and holds no key.
